title: Harold

sources.title: Haroldish Doom
markers: | summary = '''Haroldish Doom''' is a passive feature that diminishes a target's combat prowess whenever you deal damage to the target.

sources.title: Piercing Shot
markers: | description = Deal regular damage and possibly inflict {{SmCond|Gaping Wounds}} which cause extra damage on attacks.

summary: A +1 heavy crossbow with a ranged-weapon Bane rider.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d10 + 1 Piercing plus Dexterity modifier, 60 ft normal range. Martial, heavy, two-handed, ammunition, loading, dippable.
fields.Haroldish Doom: When you deal ranged weapon damage, target makes a DC 13 Charisma save. Failure gives −1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws for 2 turns.
fields.Piercing Shot: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Make a ranged weapon attack. On hit, the target makes a Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2. Failure causes Gaping Wounds for 2 turns, or 4 with Crossbow Expert: Wounding. Undead and Constructs are immune to this rider.
fields.Base value: 380 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
